item.title: CVE-2026-81578
item.description: An improper access control vulnerability exists in the web management interface of PaperCut MF and PaperCut NG. Under specific conditions, unauthenticated remote requests targeting administrative functions can trigger backend actions prior to the completion of access validation checks. This allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to modify certain system configurations.

item.title: CVE-2026-82078
item.description: An unsafe dynamic class loading vulnerability exists in the database connection utilities of PaperCut MF and PaperCut NG. The application instantiates database driver classes based on configurable driver names without validating against an allowlist of approved drivers. If an attacker can manipulate system configuration parameters, this enables the execution of arbitrary Java bytecode residing on the application classpath under the security context of the PaperCut server process.

A patch is available, so it is essential to update your software immediately to protect your network from potential attacks. Please prioritize this action to prevent any service disruptions.

item.title: CVE-2026-115731
item.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in the report-processing code of Puppet, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected releases, allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as its service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type via PUT request. Where the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain such a certificate.

item.title: CVE-2026-63030
item.description: WordPress 6.9.x before 6.9.5 and 7.0.x before 7.0.2 is affected by a REST API batch endpoint route confusion issue which, combined with the author__not_in WP_Query SQL Injection (CVE-2026-60137), could allow an attacker to perform SQL Injection and achieve Remote Code Execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-5195
item.description: A critical vulnerability exists in the Linux kernel that can allow local users to gain unauthorized access to system privileges. This weakness has been exploited in the past and does have a patch available. It is highly recommended that you update your Linux systems to the latest version to protect against potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2024-36401
item.description: GeoServer has a critical vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary code, affecting all versions before 2.22.6, 2.23.6, 2.24.4, and 2.25.2. Patches are available for these versions, and it's recommended to upgrade immediately or, as a temporary measure, remove the gt-complex module, which may affect functionality. Ensure all instances of GeoServer are secured to prevent potential exploitation.

item.title: CVE-2025-20352
item.description: Cisco IOS and IOS XE software have a critical vulnerability in their Simple Network Management Protocol that could allow low-privileged attackers to cause a service outage, or high-privileged attackers to gain complete control of the device. A patch is available to fix this issue. It is crucial to apply the patch immediately to protect your systems from potential attacks.

item.title: CVE-2025-7775
item.description: Citrix has identified a critical memory overflow vulnerability in the NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway products, which can allow hackers to execute remote code or cause service interruptions. A patch is available, and it's crucial to apply it immediately to protect your systems. Ensure that all configurations, especially involving IPv6, are reviewed as part of this update.

item.title: CVE-2026-123890
item.description: VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service. Affected versions: 9.1.x (fixed in 9.1.1.0200); 9.0.x (fixed in 9.0.2.0200); 8.0 (fixed in 8.0 U3m); 5.x (fixed in 5.2.5). Telco Cloud Platform 3.0, 4.x, 5.0.x, 5.1.x, 5.2 and Telco Cloud Infrastructure 3.0 are also affected (see KB463116).
